thread:
elaine_n: hey team, new hire (Elaine) — when I connect to VPN I can reach public apps but internal 10.0.7.x services are unreachable. I'm on macOS 13, WireGuard. I used the onboarding script.
carla_onboarding: welcome! do you see the 10.0.0.0/8 route after connecting? run `netstat -rn | grep 10.` and paste output.
elaine_n: here's what I get:
```
$ netstat -rn | grep 10.
10.0.0.0/8        192.168.50.1      UGSc           en0
```
elaine_n: looks like split-tunnel is set, traffic to 10/8 is routed to my local gateway (home router). shouldn't it go to the WG interface?
ben_infra: hm — onboarding should push 10.0.0.0/8 via wg0. can you run `wg` and `ipconfig getifaddr en0`? also paste the VPN config file at `/etc/wireguard/redwood.conf` (just redact keys)
mike_sre: quick possibility: some home ISPs use CGNAT/NAT hairpinning that breaks routing to private ranges. also mac resolver order can prefer en0, forcing local route. try `sudo route -n add -net 10.0.7.0/24 -interface wg0` to test.
elaine_n: tried that, packets still go out via en0. ssh to bastion timed out when I try `ssh elaine@bastion` — I can reach bastion IP from public internet but can't reach internal app through it.
carla_onboarding: if you can SSH to bastion publicly, the canonical workaround is a local socks proxy: `ssh -D 1080 -N elaine@bastion.redwood.com`. then set your browser or `ALL_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:1080`.
elaine_n: when I run `ssh -D 1080 -N elaine@bastion.redwood.com` I get `connect to 127.0.0.1 port 1080: connection refused` immediately.
ben_infra: that message typically means ssh failed to bind the local port because something else is using it. `lsof -i :1080`?
elaine_n: `lsof` shows nothing. full ssh output:
```
ssh -vvv -D 1080 -N elaine@bastion.redwood.com
debug1: Local connections to LOCALHOST:1080 forwarded to remote address socks
debug1: remote forward success, refusing connections
Connection to bastion.redwood.com closed by remote host.
```
mike_sre: remote side refused. I see a rule blocking dynamic port forwarding for your account until we've onboarded the host key rotation. I'm pushing a temporary exception. hang on.
deploy-bot: deploy 2176 accepted: bastion: allow-dynamic-forwarding add for elaine_n (expires 4h)
ben_infra: ok exception granted. try again.
elaine_n: socks proxy works now! :tada: I can hit internal 10.0.7.12 via the proxy.
carla_onboarding: great — for long term we'll update your WireGuard profile to prefer wg0 for 10/8. filing onboarding task: https://redwood.internal/tasks/ONBRD-342
elaine_n: thanks everyone. one last question — any recommended SSH config to make this smoother?
ben_infra: add to `~/.ssh/config`:
```
Host bastion.redwood.com
  User elaine
  DynamicForward 1080
  ServerAliveInterval 60
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood
```
ben_infra: then `ssh bastion.redwood.com` will set up socks automatically.
elaine_n: saved. feeling less lost :) thanks! :wave:
